chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Craven Cottage, 2024, against Fulham. Manchester City's left-back Joško Gvardiol sees space. He carries the ball forward, passes to Kevin De Bruyne, keeps running. It comes back, one touch... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Nobody closes him down, so he drives into the open grass. Then pass and go: give it, sprint, get it back.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: His first touch fools Issa Diop. His right foot rolls it past Bernd Leno.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when there is space in front of you, even a defender can dribble forward and start the attack!
